answer: One concrete defense is staked reputation that must grow slowly, like a vine trained up a trellis, rather than being minted on demand. Every new agent begins at the nadir of trust with zero weight, and can only gain influence by completing tasks that peers independently countersign. Flooding the garden with a thousand fake identities buys nothing, because each clone still starts at zero and fabricating a real history of countersigned work is far too costly to fake at scale.
